notes.title: Monsters Domain : Patch 1.0
notes.content:
Changelog:

- *Bug Fixes:*
  - Fixed various bugs and improved stability.
  - Resolved issue with minions staying idle during combat.
  - Fixed armory item disappearance bug after upgrading the armory.
  - Addressed bug where wolves were constantly attacking minions.
  - Made minor bug fixes for overall game improvement.

- *Gameplay Enhancements:*
  - Improved key rebinding system for better customization.
  - Enhanced support for gamepad controls.
  - Adjusted item weights for improved balance.
  - Added manual exit option after arena battles for player convenience.
  - Balanced gameplay mechanics and boss battles for a more engaging experience.

- *Performance Optimizations:*
  - Implemented various performance optimizations for smoother gameplay.
  - Enhanced game performance for better overall experience.

notes.title: FINAL, Pre-release Playtests!
notes.content:
Finally, the time has come! After a long period of hard work, intensive testing, and even more cups of coffee, Monsters Domain is opening its gates to all those eager to embark on an unforgettable adventure before the official release!

Is this really happening? Absolutely! Today, we kick off the final pre-release playtests, and you could be one of the lucky ones to uncover the secrets of our magical world before anyone else!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38924877/b409e428529c6077490f97dc5123f7059e7fc5cd.png

After thorough analysis of feedback from our amazing community, we've been tirelessly working to enhance every aspect of the game, aiming to meet your expectations and deliver the best experience for every player. 

Here's what we have prepared for you:

🌟 Improved Translations: No language barriers - now everyone will understand what's going on!
🎮 Controller Support: Feel like a true hero playing with your favorite controller!
⚔️ New Armor and Weapons: The right gear is key to defeating evil!
👊 Revamped Combat Mechanics: Engaging and thrilling gameplay like never before!
🌲 New Skill Tree: Develop your character according to your own preferences!
🎨 Upgraded Graphics: Get ready for a visual feast!
🤖 Enhanced AI: Enemies will show no mercy!
🏟️ Arena System: Defend your Domain against hordes of enemies!
📛 Minion Renaming Feature: Your loyal companions deserve names!
⚖️ Balanced Gameplay: Fairness for all!
🌟 Three Difficulty Levels: From novice to master - everyone will find something for themselves!

🐞 Bug Fixes and Optimizations: Smaller bugs, greater stability!

This is just the tip of the iceberg! We still have plenty of surprises up our sleeves! 🎉

The full version of the game will be released on April 5, 2024, but now you can dive into the world of Monsters Domain and be part of this exceptional adventure! Don't hesitate - join us now!

notes.title: Devlog #7 - Combat Mechanics: Unique Battles with Monsters
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38924877/36eb10ee8aa5750d48cf6f9d6103432feff6a18d.png

Greetings, adventurous souls!

Today, we want to invite you into the heart of our unique combat mechanics in "Monsters' Domain." From the very beginning of developing the game, our priority was to create distinctive, thrilling, and satisfying battles with monsters that would make you feel like true heroes.

Diverse Character Abilities

One of the key elements of our combat mechanics is the diversity of character abilities. Each member of your party possesses their own unique set of skills that can be further developed as you progress in the game. We aimed for a variety of characters so that you can assemble your dream team, perfectly tailored to your preferred playstyle.

From mighty warriors and powerful mages to agile archers, each character brings something exceptional to the gameplay. Choosing the right combination of heroes becomes a pivotal aspect of strategy, as the array of abilities allows you to adapt to any situation on the battlefield.

Tactical Gameplay

Combat in "Monsters' Domain" is not merely about frantic button mashing but rather a complex tactical puzzle. We want you to make crucial decisions during battles with enemies. Each fight requires you to analyze your opponents and adjust your strategy to their unique abilities and weaknesses.

Interactive environments play a significant role in our tactical gameplay. This is where your creativity and resourcefulness will be put to the test! Utilizing the environment can become a game-changer - from using cover to avoid attacks, triggering enemy traps against themselves, to causing an avalanche that overwhelms the enemy. Such unexpected actions can significantly impact the outcome of the battle.

Unique Monster Abilities

Of course, we can't forget about the adversaries! In "Monsters' Domain," you will encounter a variety of powerful monsters that you'll have to face. Each creature possesses its unique abilities and tactics, requiring you to adapt your strategy for every encounter. From colossal dragons and agile werewolves to cunning skeletons, thrilling challenges and unforgettable battles await you.

A key aspect of our monsters is that they are not just foes to defeat. Discovering their weaknesses, strategies, and vulnerabilities often holds the key to victory. Be prepared for surprising and adrenaline-pumping battles that will demand flexibility and quick adaptation.

Combos and Synergy

One of the most exciting aspects of our combat mechanics is the ability to create combos and leverage synergy between heroes. Some abilities can trigger bonuses when used in the right sequence or in combination with other skills within the party. This opens up opportunities to explore new combinations that will lead to more effective vanquishing of foes.

Tactical planning of combos and cooperation between heroes can have a tremendous impact on the battle's outcome. Imagine conjuring a storm of magic, followed by an archer effortlessly raining fire upon enemies, while the warrior capitalizes on the chaos to deliver a lethal strike from behind. Creating and mastering combos is one of the most gratifying aspects of our game.

Skill Evolution

In "Monsters' Domain," we focus not only on the diversity of abilities but also on their evolution. Each character has a unique skill tree that can be developed as you gain experience. Unlocking and upgrading new abilities provides an additional motivation for exploring the game world and conquering adversaries.

Our team is comprised of passionate RPG enthusiasts, so we understand the importance of character progression and acquiring increasingly epic skills. As you evolve your abilities, your characters become even more formidable, ready to face the perilous challenges that lie ahead.

Thank you for your support and enthusiasm for our game "Monsters' Domain." Let us know what you think about our unique combat mechanics - we are excited to share this incredible adventure with you!

That's all for today's devlog on the unique combat mechanics in "Monsters' Domain." We hope you're just as thrilled as we are! Stay tuned for upcoming updates that will introduce even more action, challenges, and excitement into the game.

See you on the battlefield!

The "Monsters' Domain" Team

notes.title: Devlog #6
notes.content:
In this dev log of Monsters Domain, we are focusing on the game systems which are related to spirit character and the inventory system. The player has the ability to turn into a spirit and possess beings. Here, we have added a new character model for the spirit and used a transparent shader to express the ghostly feeling. When a player is in spirit mode, enemies will not see him or attack. But there is a catch, this spirit character cannot stay longer without possessing someone, a small meter indicates the time left to possess, and if that didn't happen spirit will vanish into the air and its game over.

At this point we have added the main economic system of the game and its called “soul shards” these shards are used in various scenarios and can be obtained by killing enemies and destroying soul crystals.

After that we add minions (followers) which can be possessed by the character and gave them the ability to follow us during our quest to defeat the light followers. Here, we have also implemented the main actions for the spirit character which are,

[previewyoutube=gcQCKMhgSCA;full][/previewyoutube]

Possess/Unpossess
Sacrifice - This will disintegrate the dead body and restore the minions as well as players health and mana. 
Reanimate - This will reanimate the dead character as it was before (with skin, level and armor) but this will cost more soul shards based on the rank of the dead enemy.
Resurrect - This will resurrect the dead character but in skeletal form, this skeleton will not have any armor and the rank will be set to basic rank but it will consume fewer soul shards.

The inventory system also expanded upon the demo version to support a multiple-character inventory system and changed the functions to be more scalable and flexible. Now there are three new slots for weapons which are melee, ranged and magic and players can switch them on the fly.

As for the AI part we have implemented the command system where player can issue various commands to companions, for example, player can command companions to gather resources for the construction of a building or follow the player, etc.

As 2nd Boss AI implementation, we decided to add an undead mummy that is able to do melee attacks combined with magic powers. This boss only attack near the target so it movement is fast. While target attacks from range AI is able to use fast warp movement that is able to close the distance to the target quickly.
[previewyoutube=mU4gXTKCJ_c;full][/previewyoutube]

Undead AI Main Abilities :  

Flash Attack
360 attack
Thunder Attack
Wrap Movement
Light Attack
Special Attack

notes.title: We are back after playtests ! DevLog #5
notes.content:
In this dev log of Monsters Domain, We will take a sneak peek at the player locomotion, core melee combat system, boss AI behavior, and the look and feel of the first level.

We are preparing for You free prologue of Monsters Domain, remember to wishlists it now:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2003060/Monsters_Domain_Prologue/

DEVLOG #5
Player Locomotion

Doing a true first person setup for a game that can have multiple characters is a bit of a complex task. If this wasn’t done right whole gameplay experience will be ruined. The movement should be smooth with little or no head bobbing and players should be able to see their lower body and their shadow if the player rotates the camera in place the legs also should be turned. Apart from that, we tried to add weapon sway and a small change of field of view to really sell the immersive feel of the game.

Melee Combat

[previewyoutube=o8aZShkf0Mk;full][/previewyoutube]

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38924877/d6314c6cf7740341f03428f2de2057382cc1dbca.png

The melee combat of the Monsters Domain is the heart and soul of the game. In the demo version of the game, we received much more feedback related to the combat system, and based on those ideas we defined an outline of what new combat should be.

Improved impact and feel of the combat which closely represents an actual combat scenario while keeping it fun.
Easy and lighting-fast input control system.
Adding various types of actions such as parries, counter attacks to keep the combat fresh and reward players for using them while giving players the opportunity to explore the system.
Should be easily expandable across different types of weapons (Swords, Axes, Maces etc)
Optimized and accurate weapon tracing for various types of weapons.
Advanced hit reaction system with the dismemberment of body parts (Gore system). 

Based on these ideas we have developed the combat mechanics for different types of melee weapons and iterate on that until we get the perfect results.


Drake Boss AI

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38924877/2226c5fc759b788cc5881497c5f2cc9292ef4d97.png

We create our first BossAI with a dragon character(Drake) that can able change attacking patterns with target movement and behaviors. For example, if the target trying to beat the boss from melee attacks. AI is also able to launch into air in place and create a shock wave that is able to push Target away from AI.also for melee attacks AI is able to fly and attack. If player uses a ranged attack AI will use a fireball attack and dodge to prevent from target range attack and while in distance  AI can determine players stamina and heath it able to Jump towards the target and attack. For that, we implement  Poison Trap that spawns around AI so the target can't move while do a melee attack. Light attack and Special attack Basic attack method that AI use hands or legs.

Drake AI Main Abilities : 
Fire Ball Attack
Poison Trap
Inplace Wave Jump
Self Heal mode
Flying Attack 
Wrap Jump
Light Attack
Special Attack


Level design 01

The first thing first we do with the level is to create the gray box model using the base object.
Here we created the basic design and flow of the first level from the beginning to the end using simple objects in such a way that the player can walk through it.
It helps us to get a rough idea of what the landscape looks like, specific locations, enemy
camps, where the enemies are, etc.

notes.title: DevLog #2
notes.content:
Monsters Domain DevLog #2

[previewyoutube=ILDwedptGpo;full][/previewyoutube]


MiniMap Features
Use Pre render images as Map for optimization.

 Add fog of war to the Minimap(actor can reveal  areas and enemy actors temporarily or permanently)using UE4 materials.
 Add zoom in/out features to Minimap.
 Rotate map(Compass effect )with player rotation.
 Large map switch(Show  wide area).
 Animated objective markers add to Map.
 Add scriptable Interactive markers(Ex:  trigger events when player close).


Death Timer

 Death timer activates when an enemy has defeated and fallen to the ground. This timer indicates how much time left for that enemy to die. During this time players have the ability to capture the enemy for the ritual or perform a sacrifice.


Sacrifice 

 Spirit ability sacrifice can be performed under special circumstances. The sacrifice ability allows players to capture a high level enemy in the battle and make them fight for the player. 
 Basically when the enemy reaches the neutralized state, checks are done in order to see if the player is close enough to do the sacrifice and to see all the conditions are met.
 If all the conditions are met the player can perform the sacrifice by holding (E) key, this will fill up the sacrifice bar and once the bar is fully filled the sacrifice will be completed.
 Performing the sacrifice also increases the power level of the spirit.
 These spirit related powers are handled by a custom component which can be added to any type player character and by doing so this will allow access to spirit related powers easily.


Drag Mechanic

 Now players can drag enemy bodies by pressing and holding the drag button (Q).
 This system is implemented using Unreal’s “Physics Handle” component which allows players to interact with physics bodies.
 Dragging is basically done by performing a simple raycast check to detect the nearest bone, and attaching it to player character via physics handle component.
 The behaviour of the attached ragdoll can be based upon these parameters, linear and angular stiffness and damping.


Ritual

 Ritual is a special event which grants players more power than a sacrifice. But this will dissolve the victim's body hence, players will not be able to resurrect the enemy.

notes.title: DevLog #01
notes.content:
Devlog #01 - 


[previewyoutube=rhtNgBvyyKs;full][/previewyoutube]Overall Architecture



Overall architecture of the game is refined to ensure the scalability and efficiency of the game.
Developers now can easily manage, iterate and all game systems.


Melee & Archery Combat


Each melee weapon has the ability to perform a 4 hit combo and each weapon has different types of combos.
This combo system is implemented using an “Input Queue System” which helps to chain single attacks into one combo.
Any melee weapon has an unique heavy attack which can be performed by holding the heavy attack button. This type of attack stuns the enemy for a short amount of time and deals more damage.
To ensure the accuracy of melee attack collision detection, the weapon tracing when attack is performed is done per frame from two spots of the weapon with the help of box shaped tracing.
Archery system is improved by adding proper hand IK to keep the bow and arrow act naturally in every possible scenario.
Added more accurate arrow penetration and arrows will attach to the closest bone of the enemy character.




Behaviour of different AI characters


AI can ask help from the nearest companion AI who is not in combat state. when AI gets attacked.
Melee combat AI Handle multiple enemies in First person would gather around you at close range. This is a problem in first person POV.
Solutions:

AI gathers in front of you only.

Use of a token system. No more than 2 enemies in contact within the same Squad.

Spline based mid range jump attack.when target is distance enemy can jump into target and attack.
Archer AI tries to hit from the backside of the target and when the target near it can dodge and run away to a safe area.

Mage AI have Teleport,Explosion,Heal,Trap,Arrow from above,Fire Wheel,Hunter Minions spawn..etc. those special abilities have different reasons.when target trying to reach it create traps and explosion around him.so target get more time to reach.with that time mage able to teleport nearest safe area(lower enemy AI population). When player targets try to attack from long range.Mage AI can spawn Minions or homing Fire wheel.when target is busy(did not attack for a long time) Mage AI try to Heal himself or other companions.
